subject.title: fix: honor configured default agent across main paths

question: After current-head real behavior proof is supplied, should maintainers adopt this broader PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90573, or prefer a narrower/sequenced path?
rationale: The code change is a plausible broad bug fix, but it changes compatibility-sensitive session/auth/default path behavior and overlaps an open narrower PR, so a maintainer should choose the canonical landing shape before merge.

options.title: Adopt this PR after proof
options.body: Require current-head live proof for a non-main default-agent setup, then use this PR as the broad canonical fix and close or supersede the narrower secrets-only PR.

options.title: Prefer the narrower secrets PR
options.body: Land only the storage-scan subset first and keep the remaining session/setup/audit work tracked separately.

options.title: Split by surface
options.body: Ask for separate PRs for session-state, auth/model discovery, setup paths, and audit labeling to reduce upgrade blast radius.

recommendation.title: Adopt this PR after proof
recommendation.body: Require current-head live proof for a non-main default-agent setup, then use this PR as the broad canonical fix and close or supersede the narrower secrets-only PR.
